This looks complete and correct — every control and image has an accessible name, no raw colours/pixels, logical properties throughout, and the grids collapse to a single `minmax(0, 1fr)` column below 640px so nothing scrolls sideways at 390px.

The policy details screen is built in `src/screens/Screen.tsx` and `src/screens/Screen.module.css`:
- **Header**: policy name, number, and a status badge (`variant="status"` pairs a dot with the word, e.g. "Active").
- **Tabs**: Cover, Documents, Payments (underline `Tabs`).
- **Cover**: two cards listing included/excluded items, each with a check or cross icon plus text (never colour alone).
- **Documents**: four mock files in a list, each with a name, type/size, and a "Download" button.
- **Payments**: a "Next payment" card with an `Amount`, and a "Last 3 payments" list with date, method, amount and a "Paid" status badge.

Mock data is defined directly in the file; both files pass the Syntara audit at 100/100. I can't run the app to visually verify, per the task constraints.
